subject: Television & Streaming
title: Murphy Brown and the Culture War
description: A quick win: understand Murphy Brown and the Culture War.

hook.text: In 1992, the fictional Murphy Brown had a baby as a single mother.

buildup.text: Quayle argued the show glamorized single motherhood and undermined family values.

discovery.text: A sitting Vice President debating a fictional character proved television's cultural power.

twist.text: The controversy boosted Murphy Brown's ratings.

climax.text: The Murphy Brown incident showed that television characters can become proxies in real political battles over values.

punchline.text: A sitcom baby started a national argument about family.

quiz.question: Why did Vice President Dan Quayle publicly criticize Murphy Brown?
options: The character had a baby as a single mother, which he said undermined family values
